GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_GAI_LV.title: Chance
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_GAI_LV.description: When triggered, roll using the percentage shown on the card. Chance can be increased or decreased by related effects.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_XU_YING.title: Phantom
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_XU_YING.description: While in your hand, whenever you play a non-Phantom Attack, roll the card's Chance to trigger its effect.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_PIN_JIE.title: Rank
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_PIN_JIE.description: Gu worms range from Rank 1 to Rank 9. Rank 6 and above are Immortal Gu. Some Gu worms increase in Rank when upgraded.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_XIAN_GU.title: Unique Immortal Gu
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_XIAN_GU.description: Gu worms of Rank 6 and above are Immortal Gu. You cannot obtain duplicate Immortal Gu; Immortal Gu you already own will not appear in combat rewards or shops. Copied cards and Phantoms are exempt.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_XIAN_GU_TYPE.title: Immortal Gu
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_BEN_MING_GU_TYPE.des: You can own only 1 per run. It is refined as your Aperture rank rises. Removing it directly costs HP equal to 80% of your Max HP, leaving at least 1 HP.
